description: The main window may only open the event channel, send commands, read a past session's log by id for a replay (LLD §9, D-027, D-081), and run the first-run screen: read its status, save a choice or a key, download a model file, ask for the microphone, open System Settings at the microphone pane (D-149), and start the session (D-100). Debug builds also grant dev_say at runtime.
